rationale: Dispatching D1 to survey the unscanned One Sansome Street URM-infill block (~9,019 occupants, 65% collapse risk) and D2 to verify the unassessed 32 Battery St block (~1,162 occupants, 65% collapse risk) that AIR 1 could not see clearly. These two blocks represent the highest concentration of potentially trapped occupants in predicted complete-collapse zones. D3 is held in reserve at Embarcadero Plaza for follow-up on newly discovered collapses.

missions.purpose: Survey the 4-building One Sansome Street URM-infill block for predicted complete collapse and trapped occupants.
Assess the 4-building 32 Battery St URM-infill block that AIR 1 could not evaluate for potential collapse.
